## 4. lore — The polite escape of paakkalaam

**ANNA:** A note. The polite escape of paakkalaam

**ANNA:** When someone says see you later here, nobody checks a calendar.

**ANNA:** அப்புறம் பார்க்கலாம்
> see you later

**ANNA:** Literally it just means we might look later. It commits to nothing.

**ANNA:** பார்க்கலாம்
> let's see

**ANNA:** It softens the goodbye so nobody feels shut out.
